page.title: Become a host
page.subtitle: Create a host profile to list and manage your rental vehicles. XePrime reviews each vehicle before it goes live on the marketplace.
page.homeAriaLabel: Go to the XePrime home page

steps.create: Create the profile: name, business type, province and contacts.
steps.complete: Fill in whatever is still missing — a complete profile can list vehicles right away.
steps.prepare: Add your first vehicle: photos, documents, rental price.
steps.publish: Submit the vehicle for review. Once approved it goes live and starts taking bookings.
steps.createShop: Create the shop: name, contact phone number and address.
steps.pay: Pick a plan, vehicle slots and term, then transfer using the QR code.
steps.logo: Upload your shop logo — required before you can submit a vehicle.
steps.activate: XePrime reviews and approves your shop account.
